"Jiang Yan, born in the second year of Tiancheng, formerly a Well of Heaven disciple. This man acts erratically, is utterly deranged, murdered his father for a jade piece, and is guilty of unforgivable crimes. A bounty is hereby issued to all members of the martial world. Whoever captures this man shall receive a generous reward."

What was laughable was that this very vendetta notice had actually been delivered to Jiang Wulang himself.

He stared at the words on the paper, feeling the whole matter had reached an absurd extreme. The truth behind his adoptive father's poisoning had yet to be uncovered, and yet this wanted notice now prevented him from openly investigating it. Jiang Wulang tightened his grip on the hilt of his sword, only to suddenly hear a faint crying from within his arms. He released his hold, tossed aside the worthless paper, and helplessly patted the child.

Citrus Fate is a female tabby. 
A few months ago, she suddenly appeared at Halo Peak. And somehow managed to climb up to the tip of the tower. 
Master Qingxuan and the monks feared she might fall, or disturb the sacred relics at the peak. 
In the end, Little Mohe managed to lure her down. Since then, she has stayed at Halo Peak, helping herself to more than a few of the pond's fish. 
Cats eat fish, fish eat bugs, and so the monks began reciting the Rebirth Sutra by the water's edge. 
Despite their concerns about killing, they couldn't resist her charm, and named her "Citrus Fate".
For the tabby cat has fate with all beings: good karma with the young hero, bad karma for the pond fish.
